source_execution_mode: Five unchanged static method AST nodes compiled into a minimal class; original functions with bundled numpy and existing isolated polars; no whole application.
convention: Population standard deviation (ddof=0), zero risk-free return, monthly annualization coefficient12. These short artificial sequences demonstrate formulas, not an investment estimate.

mechanism.group_nav: cum_prod(1+group_return) outputs first point after first period, no initial1 row
mechanism.periods_for_win_sharpe: arr[1:]/arr[:-1]-1 with positive previousNAV only; initialNAV-to-firstpoint return is absent
mechanism.std: np.std uses default population ddof0; monthly annualization coefficient12
mechanism.full_sequence_recovery: Prepend known initialNAV1 or use original group returns to retain the first period; this is explanatory, no source patch made

independent_check.method: Non-blind to worker result; independent exact Fraction formulas, no worker implementation read or rerun, no source methods invoked

limitations: Only the pinned group_nav/group_stats source pair and synthetic positive-NAV example were checked.
Total return includes the first period; do not describe the entire first return as missing from NAV or profit.
Source long-short return reconstruction separately prepends1.0; this finding is not generalized to all long-short statistics.
No actual site deployment identity, private period returns, account performance or same runtime bug established.
Nominal first-of-month dates are synthetic calendar inputs, not certified exchange sessions.
scope: Source-function demonstration with independent arithmetic check; not a deployed-site bug or profitable-strategy conclusion.
